issue_request: FHIR-11466 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for DSTU2 asking the Administration module to add a quick overview/list of topics, improve the poor Patient Registers label, and make each topic a heading so the areas could be linked.
initial_application: The 2016 source commit 1a2593c7e73bdcfb2048b52db27ae6869c97daad, labeled for trackers 11466, 11469, 11248, 10636, and 11470, appears to have applied FHIR-11466 by adding the Administration module index table and replacing resource-category macro rows with explicit h4 topic sections. It still used the old Patient Registers label, which was later refined.
additional_context: source/administration-module.html is active build-scope source through publish.ini [pages] and [special-pages] and source/hierarchy.xml. The current page includes an Index with linked resources and anchored h4 sections for Patient/Person Registries, Clinical / Financial Categorization Resources, Service Provider Directory Resources, Scheduling and Appointments, Devices and Substances, and Research Studies and Subjects. Later Published/Persuasive issue FHIR-15792 requested Patient/Person Registries wording and the current descriptive paragraph, and that later same-page decision is now present.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already satisfies FHIR-11466's implementer-visible requirements, and adding another topic list would duplicate existing page structure rather than correct a current specification problem.
